WTF. After even more digging and rabbit holing, I found three things that profoundly helped me (to the point where I sleep like a baby every night):

  1. Blue-blocking sunglasses that I wear at night. I look kind of ridiculous wearing these orange sunglasses indoors at night, but hey I like sleeping more than looking cool.

  2. I found this really potent guided meditation thing for my pineal gland here that works like magic for all kinds of stuff. I mainly listen to it about 30 min to 10 min before I go to sleep and it makes a noticeable difference in helping me relax and it gives me cool dreams ; )

  3. Getting outside and into broad daylight/sunlight during the day. This also has a noticeable effect. If I don't do this consistently I REALLY feel it (in a not good way).

Good luck to anyone else struggling with any of this ~
